description: Send a one-time verification code (OTP) to a phone number by text, or to an email address with channel "email". TextKit generates the code, handles expiry (10 min) and attempt limits (5), and blocks SMS-pumping and email-bombing abuse.

app_name.description: Your product name, shown in the message

channel.description: How the code goes out. `sms` needs `phone`; `email` needs `email`.

customer_id.description: Optional: attribute the verification to one of your customers

email.description: The address to email the code to (channel `email`). Disposable addresses are refused.

from.description: Optional, channel `sms` only: send from a number you own instead of the TextKit pool

idempotency_key.description: Optional. Retries are already safe: the same call with the same inputs within 10 minutes is done once and answers with the first result. Pass your own key to dedupe across a longer gap, or a new one to repeat an identical call on purpose.

phone.description: The number to text the code to (channel `sms`). `to` works too.

user_ip.description: Optional. Your end user's IP address, as your server saw it. With it, one person requesting codes for many numbers or addresses is limited (20 an hour per IP on your account, texts and emails together); without it there is no per-IP limit, since requests come from your server.

name: send_verification
title: Send verification
